title: Add contrast-set probing scorer and density-weighted regression gate for granular CI explainability
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We frequently see regressions flagged by binary CI gates with limited context for triage. This PR introduces a contrast-set probing scorer plus a density-weighted regression gate that surfaces fine-grained, prompt-level explainability inside CI runs. The goal is to let engineers answer: which prompts changed semantics, which prompts are within expected variance, and which represent meaningful drift needing rollback.

What this PR does (summary): adds a contrast-set generator and scorer that computes per-prompt delta-to-nearest-contrast-anchor using edit/semantic similarity and model-output divergence; implements a density-weighted gating layer that downweights high-density prompt clusters (reduces noisy failures from unstable cohorts) and upweights sparse/semantically-important prompts; wires both into the CI reporter so any failing eval run emits an explainability artifact (contrast_anchor.json + localized delta report) and an aggregated gate decision (pass/warn/fail).

Why this is different: existing gates operate on cohort-aggregates and simple thresholds. The density weighting improves signal-to-noise for heterogeneous prompt sets and the contrast anchors give immediate qualitative context in triage (example anchor prompt + model outputs attached). This reduces time-to-diagnosis for regressions caused by subtle prompt-template drift or tokenization changes.

Backwards compatibility: feature is opt-in via eval config (contrast_set: enabled) and defaults to off for legacy pipelines. No API surface changes to the external eval harness runner.

Related: ENG-4921 (contrast-set research spike), ENG-4999 (CI triage improvements).

Checklist: [x] Unit tests for scorer and gate; [x] Integration test that exercises CI reporter artifact generation; [x] Docs update with example explainability artifact; [x] Add feature flag and config schema; [x] Performance microbench and budget notes in PR.

Notes on rollout: enable by default for staging eval pipelines for two weeks before turning on for main smoke gates. If we see high false positive rates, the gate will fall back to cohort-aggregate mode automatically (soft-fail path).

release_notes: Introduce an opt-in contrast-set explainability hook and density-weighted regression gate for CI. Helps reduce noisy false positives and provides prompt-level failure context. Not enabled by default; see docs/contrast_sets.md for rollout steps and config.
notes:
Performance: scorer adds ~12-18ms per prompt for semantic-similarity computation when using the default (cached) encoder; memory budget limited with streaming aggregator. Integration tested with 50k prompt smoke harness.

Security: artifacts contain prompt text and model outputs; reporter respects eval config privacy flags and will redact PII when redact_pii: true is set.

Operational: when enabled, CI artifacts are retained for 30 days by default and indexed for quick triage via internal viewer.
